youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Psalm 121:1-2 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Look up for a second. This is where help comes from.

"I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth." Psalm 121:1-2 (KJV)

Your help isn't coming from the boss, the bank, or the news. It's coming from him.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
